name: 177Lu-PSMA-I&T
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "A second PSMA radioligand, chemically different from Pluvicto, that has passed two phase 3 trials on progression but has not yet shown a survival benefit."
fields.after: "177Lu-PSMA-I&T is a second PSMA radioligand, chemically different from Pluvicto, that has passed two phase 3 trials on progression but has not yet shown a survival benefit."
